# Contributing

This repo is extracted from the DeCleanup Network production stack.
The canonical source of truth for contracts is currently in
[decleanup-main-celo](https://github.com/DeCleanup-Network/decleanup-main-celo/tree/main/contracts).

If you are adding a feature here, please open a corresponding issue
in the main app repo so changes stay in sync until the extraction is complete.

Good first issues are labeled `good first issue`.
